title: finding(skills): spec@objectui shift-end report 2026-09-02 — two principle gaps (types-face routing vs. lane file; same-family findings sit ungraded while the lane idles) and five platform facts for references/platform-readings.md
body:
Shift-end report of the spec@objectui execution seat (session `session_01V3hPr7riucnMfhcHY86Msd`, 2026-09-02T01:45Z–06:35Z; seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5734), filed as a `finding` for the skills seat per the three-category shift-end discipline (SKILL.md 座位贴协议: 原则错/缺 · 可机械化项 · 平台事实变化). No prose lessons; each item is self-contained. Grading is the skills seat's.

## ① 原则错/缺 (two items)

**1. `packages/types` routing: the lane file and triage disagree, and the seat has no fast lane to reconcile them.** `references/lanes/spec.md` says objectui's contract face (`packages/types`, schema corpus, spec-pin coupling) belongs to the spec seat, yet triage routinely routes `packages/types` cards to `domain:ui` (measured today in objectui: #6910, #6951, #7080, #7014, #7129, #7113, #6952 — all `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, all landing in `packages/types`). Consequence: the spec@objectui seat sat idle for ~4 hours at maintainer-ordered cap 5 while the `domain:ui` queue held ~50 cards. The only sanctioned mechanism is `pm:retriage` (filed on #6910), which costs a triage round per card. Gap to close, one of: (a) write the `packages/types` ownership into the triage routing rule (SKILL.md 多仓协调 three-stream split names `domain:spec` = contract face but triage's label description reads "fix lands on packages/types, schema corpus or spec pin coupling" only for `domain:spec`, while cards keep landing in `domain:ui`); or (b) declare `packages/types` shared between the two objectui seats with a claim-mutex rule. Either is a SKILL/lane-file edit, not a per-card fix.

**2. Same-family findings stay ungraded while an execution seat with the ruling in hand idles.** #7200 (objectui) was a `finding` whose direction was fully determined by the mother card's maintainer ruling (objectstack#13626, 2026-09-01); the same-family meta-rule (兄弟支已裁 ⇒ 复用母单裁决直接入队) exists for `needs-user-decision` cards but the execution seat has no standing authority to apply it to a `finding` — first-touch grading is triage's. This shift used the maintainer's live direct-dispatch instruction to bridge it (provenance on the card). Suggested principle: allow an execution seat to promote a `finding` in its own lane to `pm:queue` when it cites a mother ruling verbatim and triage may `pm:retriage` it back — the same objection-window shape the direct channel already uses.

## ② 可机械化项 (one item)

- A card auto-closed by a merged `Fixes` PR keeps `pm:dispatched` for minutes (#5213: stripped by a workflow ~5 min after merge; #7200: still present 2 min after merge, stripped by the seat). The strip should be the merge workflow's, not the seat's — a workflow on `issues.closed` that removes `pm:*` labels would close the window.

## ③ 平台事实变化 (five items, for `references/platform-readings.md`)

1. An HTML comment written inside backticks in an issue comment is stripped by the sanitizer to an empty code span on read-back; the decision-facets marker survives only in escaped spelling (ampersand-lt / ampersand-gt form) — measured on objectui#6153 / #2731 comments today.
2. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` derives nothing for objectui paths ("absent from this tree") and `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair N` cannot read GitHub from the CCR container (HTTP 403, exit 3) — the objectui seat verifies the clause-② dual carrier by hand and quotes the tier as its own judgment.
3. The os-dev subagent reports repo-scoped REST as `403 GitHub access is not enabled for this session` and reads cards through the public web page's embedded-JSON payload; MCP writes work. Report comments still land.
4. `check_suite.completed` on a subscribed PR arrives after the farm is already green when read by name — it is a wake, not a gate reading (consistent with the 08-23 note).
5. `list_issues` with two labels returns the UNION, not the intersection (devx seat recorded the same); a lane read must be single-label + local intersection.

Refs: objectui#5734 (seat post with the full ledger), objectui#7200 / PR #7278 (the direct-channel precedent), objectui#6910 (the retriage in flight).
